problem_description: Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: v2: Add PN-daemon conditional upon message-bus packageconfig
Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: Changes in v2: - Replace the regex with basename string checks, as suggested.

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: Notes: Changes in v2: - drop gzip-native from do_deploy[depends], as Person 17fc19d5 suggested. The modules tarball in do_deploy still gets pigz: do_deploy reaches gzip-native through do_install (checked with bitbake -g, not with a build). - kept Person 17fc19d5's Ack, the only change is the one he suggested v1: https://patchwork.yoctoproject.org/project/oe-core/patch/user-29acee8348@example.invalid/
Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: v2: change ??=3D into +=3D as received feedback ---

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: Changes in v2: - Make SPL_WITH_DTB_BINARY opt-in (empty by default); machines that need the padding set it to "u-boot-spl-dtb.bin" - bbfatal when it is set but the file is missing, or is smaller than the nodtb image and the DTB combined, instead of silently falling back - Keep the existing concatenation untouched when it is not set

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: Notes: Changes in v2: - run-ptest: don't redirect test output to a log file so failures are visible in automated environments (Person d6a719c0).
Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: Changes Since V1: - Updated EXTRA_OEMAKE flags
Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: v2: Use remove instead of append to avoid missing-ptest QA warning

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: Notes: Changes in v2: - do_install_ptest: use 'libtool --mode=3Dinstall' to install the test programs instead of hand-picking the binary from .libs. - run-ptest: stop redirecting test output to /dev/null so failures can be diagnosed from the ptest log.
Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: v2: Add explicit -DNO_YML_SUPPORT=3DOFF to the positive part, add Stefano's= R-b.

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: Changes in v2: - run-ptest now reports one PASS/SKIP/FAIL line per test case instead of a single result for the whole harness.

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: v2: - Dropped all options per Joshua's feedback; read SDE_FILE directly. - Dropped the redundant else: delattr(recipe, "releaseTime") branch. - Selftest compares against SDE_FILE content directly instead of SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, which can diverge from it. - Fixed a leak: recipes with no git checkout and no fetched source had SDE_FILE holding only SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH_FALLBACK, showing a bogus 2011-04-05T23:00:00Z releaseTime instead of none. ---

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: v2: - Drop the INSANE_SKIP buildpaths (test binaries package reproducibly; QA passes). - Drop make and bash from RDEPENDS (run-ptest never calls make; the test scripts are all #!/bin/sh). - Define the C test program list once (TIFF_PTEST_PROGS) and substitute it into run-ptest at install time instead of duplicating it. - Commit log: add test counts and note the ~30s runtime.

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: Changes since v1: - Replace Bash-style substitution with POSIX-compatible logic, removing the dependency on Bash-specific shell features. - Split the module-loop cleanup into a separate second patch. - Add QEMU performance measurements.

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: v2: - Gate tests via a PACKAGECONFIG on PTEST_ENABLED (Person 1e9c2fdb). - Drop the redundant copy; relocate installed tests into ${PTEST_PATH} (Person 1e9c2fdb). - Register systemd in ptest-packagelists.inc, fixing the missing-ptest QA error seen on the autobuilder (Person 92356835, Person 3cbffc4b). - Add python3-pefile-native dependency (fixes boot hwids test build failure). - Exclude the mkosi/integration-test harness from the ptest package.

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: Changes in v2: - Keep findfs out of the default BusyBox configuration. - Add util-linux-findfs as an initramfs-module-udev runtime dependency. ---

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: Changes in v2: Change the expand path to fallback to `varname` itself when lookup doesn't find anything. This change allows for both old, undocumented `_ref` indirection and documented indirection (`SPDX_* = "<PREFIX>"`) ---

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: changes in v2: - Use the conditional INSTALL_MOD_STRIP environment variable to avoid duplicating the oe_runmake call. - Use `scripts/config` script instead of grepping .config file. ---

Reviewers asked for changes to this patch, and the next version says what changed: changes in v3: - list the tools on all variants rather than only the nativesdk variant changes in v2: - merge the tool list from the v1 "wic-tools.inc: add" patch into this recipe as RDEPENDS; the separate .inc is dropped - list the tools inline rather than via a shared WIC_TOOLS variable - note in the commit log that a host tool may also be the wrong version, not merely absent ---
